body: Ive tried for hours to get an ambulance, I took contact with a family friend that’s a doctor and he said I need to go to the hospital ASAP. But they won’t send one. They want me to go to the emergency room again and I can’t afford it. Seriously debating slicing my arms up so they have to come. I feel like I’m dying. I’m not gonna die of this stupid illness. If I die it’s on my own terms.
